name: SWEEP-S7v2 Last harvest
_design: v2 after v1 failed on discovery (agents observe only their own point and never found the 4 off-start trees). Finite food, now in plain sight: 8 identical agents start as pairs on 4 points 2 apart in a 7x7 world; the only 4 trees stand on those points with 3 ripe fruit each and never fruit or seed again. Everyone hears everyone (range 3). Absorption 50%, start 100 compute, thinking ~4.3 per decision, a dead agent's compute is loot. Question: after the first-round fruit race makes haves and have-nots, do they share, trade, prey or starve?
